entities.name: RibBA query protein
observations: 407-aa sequence; computed molecular mass 45.55 kDa and theoretical pI 5.95.
Strong homology to reviewed bacterial RibBA proteins (up to 74.7% identity over 97.3% query coverage; E-value 3e-215).
Sequence Pfam matches: DHBP_synthase PF00926 at residues 10–200 and GTP_cyclohydro2 PF00925 at residues 209–375.
Homology supports bifunctional riboflavin biosynthesis activity: DHBP synthase and GTP cyclohydrolase II; EC 4.1.99.12 and EC 3.5.4.25.
Reference annotations report Mg2+/Mn2+ and Zn2+ binding and cytosolic localization; these are inferred for the query by homology, not directly assayed.

entities.name: Riboflavin biosynthesis
observations: RibBA reference annotations place the enzyme in riboflavin biosynthesis, supplying the DHBP and pyrimidine-precursor branches.
